lines.text: Two miles into her first overnight, Rosa's shoulders were burning.
The hip belt hung loose around her waist, so the straps carried everything.
Her friend fixed it in thirty seconds.
Hip belt first, sitting on the hip bones, pulled snug.
Then the shoulder straps, just firm.
Heavy things packed close to your back.
The weight dropped onto her hips, and her shoulders let go.
Save this before your first night on the trail.
